name: adea-ui
description: The Adea design system: one themed component library shared by Adea and Cortana.

scripts.dev: bun run --cwd packages/ui cn:build && turbo run dev --filter=@adea-ai/storybook --env-mode=loose
scripts.test: turbo run test && bun run test:coverage
scripts.storybook: bun run --cwd packages/ui cn:build && bun run --cwd apps/storybook storybook
scripts.storybook:build: bun run --cwd packages/ui cn:build && bun run --cwd apps/storybook build-storybook
